name: Table

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A native <table> inside a horizontally scrolling container, like shadcn's
  # Table: wide tables scroll instead of wrapping their cells. Attributes go
  # to the <table>; the wrapper is data-slot="table-container".
  class Table < Base
    def view_template(&block)
      div(data: {slot: "table-container"}, class: "relative w-full overflow-x-auto") do
        table(**attrs, &block)
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "table"},
        class: "w-full caption-bottom text-sm"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class TableBody < Base
    def view_template(&)
      tbody(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "table-body"},
        class: "[&_tr:last-child]:border-0"
      }
    end
  end
end

# Table

A responsive table component.

## Usage

### With footer

```ruby
Table do
  TableCaption { "A list of your recent invoices." }
  TableHeader do
    TableRow do
      TableHead(class: "w-[100px]") { "Invoice" }
      TableHead { "Status" }
      TableHead { "Method" }
      TableHead(class: "text-right") { "Amount" }
    end
  end
  TableBody do
    invoices.each do |invoice|
      TableRow do
        TableCell(class: "font-medium") { invoice.identifier }
        TableCell { invoice.status }
        TableCell { invoice.method }
        TableCell(class: "text-right") { format_amount(invoice.amount) }
      end
    end
  end
  TableFooter do
    TableRow do
      TableCell(colspan: 3) { "Total" }
      TableCell(class: "text-right") { format_amount(invoices.sum(&:amount)) }
    end
  end
end
```

### With badges

```ruby
Table do
  TableHeader do
    TableRow do
      TableHead { "Invoice" }
      TableHead { "Status" }
      TableHead(class: "text-right") { "Amount" }
    end
  end
  TableBody do
    invoices.each do |invoice|
      TableRow do
        TableCell(class: "font-medium") { invoice.identifier }
        TableCell { render_status_badge(invoice.status) }
        TableCell(class: "text-right") { format_amount(invoice.amount) }
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### With actions

```ruby
Table do
  TableHeader do
    TableRow do
      TableHead { "Product" }
      TableHead { "Price" }
      TableHead(class: "text-right") { "Actions" }
    end
  end
  TableBody do
    [["Wireless Mouse", "$29.99"], ["Mechanical Keyboard", "$129.99"], ["USB-C Hub", "$49.99"]].each do |product, price|
      TableRow do
        TableCell(class: "font-medium") { product }
        TableCell { price }
        TableCell(class: "text-right") do
          DropdownMenu do
            DropdownMenuTrigger do
              Button(variant: :ghost, size: :icon, class: "size-8") do
                more_icon
                span(class: "sr-only") { "Open menu" }
              end
            end
            DropdownMenuContent(align: :end) do
              DropdownMenuItem { "Edit" }
              DropdownMenuItem { "Duplicate" }
              DropdownMenuSeparator()
              DropdownMenuItem(variant: :destructive) { "Delete" }
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```
